hover.defaultHint: Six objects can be explored in any order.

quickIndex.title: ROOM INDEX
headline: Everything in
the room.
quickIndex.description: Use this index if you want the portfolio without the scavenger hunt. The room and the files contain the same work.

computer.label: COMPUTER
computer.hint: Most of the formal work is filed here.
computer.log: The desktop holds project case files, research and internship records, and the working notes that connect them.

drawer.label: DESK DRAWER
drawer.hint: Something was left beneath the workbench.
drawer.log: The drawer holds the physical side of the work: EMG hardware, prototypes, components, and printed traces of earlier iterations.

notebook.label: RESEARCH BOOK
notebook.hint: The margins may say more than the notes.
notebook.log: The notebook follows questions through models, tests, revisions, and the uncertainty that remains after the data is processed.

books.label: BOOKSHELF
books.hint: Some references were marked for a reason.
books.log: The shelf connects allocation algorithms, signal processing, user-centered design, and data research.

board.label: NOTE BOARD
board.hint: Not every plan was meant to stay here.
board.log: The board records working principles: ask people, expose assumptions, test the tradeoff, and make the result useful.

fieldcase.label: FIELD CASE
fieldcase.hint: The work continues beyond the workstation.
fieldcase.log: The case holds community observations, future study plans, and questions about how technical systems meet real people and places.
